name: lineart
title: Line art — black ink on paper
status_note: Visual direction only (2026-11-11): the writer gets this brief, but painted bases, the host cut-out, inserts and props exist only for cozy, so a render still uses the cozy art. Painting this pack's library is the next step before a lineart video.

reference.note: Visual direction adapted from kaomei/stickman-video-director (MIT), style B1 Minimal Hand-Drawn. Our own rig, painting and compositor; only the look is adapted. See docs/KAOMEI_INTEGRATION.md.

cast.description: the host: a slender black-ink stick figure, modest round head, black oval eyes, expressive brows
a second slender ink figure with a short marker-red scarf

palette.paper: near-white warm paper with an extremely faint square grid
palette.ink: fine, slightly irregular black pen lines

accents.marker red: a problem, a warning, an idea ruled out

palette.rule: at most these three saturated accents in a video, each with its one meaning

text.scene_text: large, short hand-lettered words as the focal point (added by the compositor, never painted)
text.captions: quiet sans-serif phrase captions in a calm paper band at the bottom

voice.note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), read at its native speed.

audio.note: No music. Narration, captions and a few restrained action sound effects below the voice.

pacing.note: Kokoro's measured rate, as for cozy. Give an action time to settle: a hold after a move is part of the look.

writer_note: Style lineart: black ink line drawings on near-white paper with a faint grid, hand-drawn props and curved arrows, at most three marker accents (yellow discovery, red problem, green answer). Describe scenes as simple ink drawings with one clear focal object and room for a big hand-lettered word; the host acts with the whole body and exaggerated faces.
